title: quality.json
description: The gate's report on one change, as data: what gate.py writes beside the quality file (`--out`) or where `--json` names. Its schema_version is raised on any change a reader could notice; a new optional field does not raise it, so a reader ignores fields it does not know. Strings hold the text as the gate read it, line breaks included, but for each byte that is not UTF-8, written as the four characters `\xNN`.

schema_version.description: The version of this format; 1 for this schema.

gate.description: ERROR when any condition failed, else OK: the word on the quality file's first line.

gate_version.description: The version of the gate.py that wrote the report, as its release names it, such as 0.3.0.

base.description: The full sha of the commit the change is measured from.

head.description: The full sha of HEAD in the work tree whose working tree, with its uncommitted edits, was judged.

failed_conditions.description: Each condition that failed the gate, a sentence as the quality file words it; empty when the gate is OK.

findings.description: Every finding, those that fail the gate first, each group in the quality file's order. Unlike the quality file, no limit applies.

findings_total.description: How many findings there are: the length of findings, which the quality file lists only up to its limit of 50.

failing_tests.description: The failing tests of every test report the gate was given; null when it was given none.

name.description: The test's name as its report gives it.

detail.description: The whole of the failure's message and text, empty when the report gives none.

coverage.description: Coverage of the lines the change added; null when the gate was given no coverage report.

lines.description: Added lines any coverage report can cover.

percent.description: (covered_lines + covered_conditions) / (lines + conditions), in percent, unrounded; 100 with nothing to cover.

unmeasured.description: Changed Python files whose names coverage.py cannot record, so that the counts leave their lines out.

suppressions.description: Each lint suppression the change added; listed for a reviewer, not counted against the change.

build_config.description: Each edit the change makes to a file that configures how the gate judges it, as the quality file's Build configuration section words it.

files.description: Every file the item is about, paths from the tree's top.

text.description: What the edit means for how the change was judged, in sentences; it may name only the first few files.

path.description: The file, from the tree's top; null for a finding about the change as a whole.

line.description: The line, from 1; null for a finding about the whole file or the whole change.

severity.description: The severity as the linter or the check words it, such as error or warning.

rule.description: The linter or check, a space, and its own rule, such as `ruff F401` or `test-integrity skip`.

check.description: The rule's first word: the linter or check that raised the finding.

fails.description: true when the finding fails the gate; false when it is only to be weighed.

fingerprint.description: 16 hex digits naming the finding across runs: the start of the SHA-256 of path (empty for null), rule and message with its ASCII digits removed, joined by NUL characters, in UTF-8. A finding that moves to another line keeps it.
